result.summary: Several layout and truncation problems hurt readability: category chips and restaurant cards are cut off, names and prices overflow or clip, and section content feels cramped at the edges.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with no ellipsis or wrapping in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow 2-line names, shrink type, or add ellipsis so full names remain readable.

issues.description: Horizontal category chips overflow the viewport; 'Healthy' is partially cut off and further options are hidden without a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll with peek of the next chip, or wrap/resize chips so all primary filters are discoverable.

issues.description: Fastest near you cards are clipped on the right; the third card is only partly visible with no strong indication of more content.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent card peek, snap scrolling, or padding so users can see and reach additional restaurants.

issues.description: Popular right now pizza card is cut off at the bottom by the tab bar, hiding part of the image and any title/meta below.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so cards aren’t obscured.

issues.description: Delivery fee under Green Bowl Poké shows '€.90 delivery' with a missing leading zero/digit formatting.
issues.suggestion: Format currency consistently as €0.90 (or local equivalent) across all cards.

issues.description: Promo banner and section spacing feel tight against rounded card edges; text and CTAs sit close to boundaries on smaller widths.
issues.suggestion: Increase internal padding and inter-section spacing for clearer hierarchy and touch targets.
